changelog: New spoken-punctuation Greek letters and per mille: with Spoken Punctuation on, say 'pi sign' (or 'পাই চিহ্ন') while dictating and π appears ('two pi sign r' → 'two π r'), 'ohm sign' → Ω ('resistance ten ohm sign' → 'resistance tenΩ'), 'micro sign' → µ ('ten micro sign farad' → 'ten µfarad'), plus delta Δ, alpha α, beta β, gamma γ, sigma σ, sum Σ, lambda λ, theta θ and 'per mille sign' → ‰ — for dictating school sums and electronics specs instead of typing π Ω µ by hand. A bare 'pi'/'micro' still types as a word. Nothing else changed — it never sends a message.
